prior_finding_assessments.rationale: The MSBuild probe observed the selector after an inline # and inside a whole quoted switch. The corrected reader identified it in both forms, and both Build-Local.ps1 and ordinary Package.ps1 refused each fixture.

The comparison normalizes separators against the four allowed imports. The forward-slash loader import reproduced the original DLL and packaged successfully. The explicit shadowed-root import still failed at both admission points.

Neither the tested commit nor the review commit tracks a root Directory.Build.rsp. The suite records clean Git status after the configuration cases. Restoring a pre-existing response file is optional fixture maintenance under OWNER AMENDMENT 2.

MSBuild read the quoted note as one BuildNote value and left DirectoryBuildTargetsPath empty. The wrapper reproduced the original DLL, its package passed, and restoring the original inputs allowed reuse of the saved receipt.
